info.name: Pilogy API V1
info.description: Existing Pilogy stateless API. Uses only fixed documentation fixtures and no credentials. Select an environment with baseUrl ending in /api/v1. Includes all five routes, all nine interpretation types, core masters, and implemented 400/404/413/415/422/500 cases. No rate-limit stress tests or destructive requests. Known draft Birthday 11 coverage cases intentionally expect 404/500. WAF/SSO responses may be non-JSON; inspect failures before retrying.

exec: throw new Error("Set baseUrl to an HTTP(S) API origin ending in /api/v1, without a trailing slash or credentials.");
